parsed.public_message: Blue confirms all four commanders are NEUTRAL as agreed. Our army holds the West Plateau high ground (west of x=320) and we have no units in the centre lowland. The four-way truce through t=300 holds firm.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 2 (t=25s): All 4 players are neutral as agreed through t=300. Hero stopped at (309,647) because direct line to (252,715) clipped the cliff cell at (260,660); moving hero north up the ramp to (275,705) and companions to (280,695) puts all squads on high ground at 364-393m from center (well inside t=300 ring of 420m) and keeps our 3 Champion Elephants hidden in fog of war on West Plateau.
parsed.explanation: With the four-way truce confirmed by all commanders, we tighten our formation on the high ground of West Plateau so every squad sits comfortably inside the 300-second ring radius. Seleucus I moves up the eastern ramp to join the main body while our heavy War Elephants remain concealed in the fog of war behind the plateau cliffs.
